note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It inherits from hv_PartA2_secfpn_2x8_cyclic_80e_kitti-3d-3class.py and overrides settings for single-class (Car) 3D detection on KITTI using PartA2 with SECOND FPN backbone.
config_model: configure the PartA2RPNHead model with 1 class (Car) and Anchor3DRangeGenerator for KITTI 3D detection
config_train_cfg: configure training settings including MaxIoUAssigner, IoUNegPiecewiseSampler, and RPN proposal parameters for PartA2
config_test_cfg: configure test-time settings with rotate NMS thresholds and score filtering for PartA2 inference
config_train_pipeline: configure the training data pipeline with ObjectSample, ObjectNoise, RandomFlip3D, and GlobalRotScaleTrans augmentations
config_test_pipeline: configure the test data pipeline with MultiScaleFlipAug3D, PointsRangeFilter, and Collect3D transforms
